fit_note: Distils repeated-run evidence into validated harness code edits around a frozen backbone, not app knowledge or tools.
Image generator acts as visual world model rolling out planner-specified trajectories; policy SFT on the synthetic rollouts.
Splits own experience into components and routes each to prompt retrieval or fine-tuning; a routing study, not retrieval alone.
Compiles repeated agent traces into reusable programs, with an online payback-aware rule for when to compile.
Hardens the model-to-browser action interface: coordinate mapping, DOM-backed select/fill, iframe fallback, feedback and executor budgets.
Bash as sole action interface, covering code/CLI control and xdotool GUI input, with a file-system workspace for tools.
Coordinate-free patch-attention search head applied recurrently, coarse-to-fine, inside one forward interaction.
Distils a validated workflow/skill library from goal-free logged trajectories and injects it with retrieved demos at test time.
Fine-tuned image-editing world model imagines multi-step mobile trajectories; policy SFT on them, real-data mixing ablated.
Dense per-step reward from a judge-certified self-verification question bank, plus verifier-based trajectory selection; not a human-labelled PRM.
